name: chart-radial
title: Chart radial
description: Visitors by browser, as bars around rings.

files.content: import { Component, computed, signal } from '@angular/core'; import { arcPath, type ChartConfig, ChartContainer, ChartLegend, ChartLegendIndicator, ChartLegendItem, ChartPlot, ChartTooltip, ChartTooltipBody, ChartTooltipIndicator, ChartTooltipItem, ChartTooltipList, ChartTooltipName, ChartTooltipValue, } from '@/ui/chart/chart'; /** * Visitors by browser, as bars around rings: each bar's length is its * share of the most visited browser's. The arrow keys move between * browsers; a hidden table holds every value. */ @Component({ selector: 'example-chart-radial', imports: [ ChartContainer, ChartLegend, ChartLegendIndicator, ChartLegendItem, ChartPlot, ChartTooltip, ChartTooltipBody, ChartTooltipIndicator, ChartTooltipItem, ChartTooltipList, ChartTooltipName, ChartTooltipValue, ], template: ` `, }) export class ChartRadialExample { protected readonly config: ChartConfig = { chrome: { label: 'Chrome', color: 'var(--chart-1)' }, safari: { label: 'Safari', color: 'var(--chart-2)' }, firefox: { label: 'Firefox', color: 'var(--chart-3)' }, edge: { label: 'Edge', color: 'var(--chart-4)' }, other: { label: 'Other', color: 'var(--chart-5)' }, }; protected readonly data = [ { browser: 'chrome', visitors: 275 }, { browser: 'safari', visitors: 200 }, { browser: 'firefox', visitors: 187 }, { browser: 'edge', visitors: 173 }, { browser: 'other', visitors: 90 }, ]; protected readonly indexes = this.data.map((_, index) => index); protected readonly active = signal(null); protected readonly current = computed(() => { const index = this.active(); return index === null ? null : this.data[index]; }); protected readonly summary = computed(() => { const row = this.current(); return row ? `${this.config[row.browser]?.label}: ${row.visitors} visitors.` : ''; }); protected readonly arcPath = arcPath; protected readonly PI = Math.PI; private readonly most = Math.max(...this.data.map((row) => row.visitors)); /** * A browser's ring, from the outside in. * * @param index - The browser's index. * @returns The ring's outer radius. */ protected ring(index: number): number { return 110 - index * 16; } /** * How far a value's bar goes around its ring. * * @param visitors - The value. * @returns The bar's end angle, in radians. */ protected angle(visitors: number): number { return (visitors / this.most) * Math.PI * 1.5; } }
